explication: FairScan is a privacy-focused Android document-scanning app. The principal flow is camera capture, automatic document detection and image enhancement, optional page review/cropping, then local PDF generation and save/share; it also supports returning a PDF to an invoking app. The graph includes settings and OCR-language management as separate capabilities. Several screen and export implementations are not excerpted, so some product-level links are documented or shown as unverified rather than asserted as source-level calls.
